description: Four-channel mixer with a voltage-controlled amplifier on every channel and on the mix

params.text: Sets the level of the mixed output, from silence to +6dB
Sets the level of that channel, from silence to +6dB

inputs.text: Controls the level of the mixed output, 0-10V
Controls the level of that channel, 0-10V

outputs.text: The four channels summed, after the mix amplifier and the MIX LVL knob
That channel on its own, after its control voltage and its fader

menu: Exponential channel VCAs — makes a channel's level rise exponentially with the voltage at its CV input rather than in proportion to it
Exponential mix VCA — makes the mix level rise exponentially with the voltage at the mix CV input rather than in proportion to it
